MOD = 998244353

def mod_inverse(x, p):
    return pow(x, p-2, p)

n, m, k = map(int, input().split())
p = mod_inverse(m, MOD)

# Compute Stirling numbers up to k
stirling = [[0]*(k+1) for _ in range(k+1)]
stirling[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, k+1):
    for j in range(1, i+1):
        stirling[i][j] = (stirling[i-1][j-1] % MOD) + (j * stirling[i-1][j]) % MOD
        stirling[i][j] %= MOD

val = 1
ans = 0
prob = 1

# Compute falling factorial
fall = 1
for i in range(k):
    fall = (fall * (n - i)) % MOD

for i in range(k, 0, -1):
    prob = (prob * p) % MOD
    ans = (ans + ((fall * prob) % MOD) * stirling[k][k-i+1]) % MOD
    # Update fall for next iteration (remove largest factor)
    if i > 1:
        fall = (fall * mod_inverse(n - (k - i), MOD)) % MOD

print(ans)
